items.headline: Lithium Carbonate wage mediation update
items.snippet: Albemarle reached preliminary wage agreement with Chilean union leaders (Salar de Atacama / La Negra); vote pending, mediation period extended two days.

items.headline: Atlas Lithium Announce ~71% Of Neves Project Capex Is Supported By Executed Contracts
items.snippet: On its Q2 2026 earnings call (Aug 6, 2026), Albemarle reported global lithium consumption grew 45% YoY through May 2026, supply lagged due to limited spodumene availability and African shipment disruptions; lithium carbonate inventories under three weeks; stationary storage ~30%

items.headline: 'We Don't Have Decades': Why $500 Million Won't Break China's Grip on Batteries
items.snippet: Albemarle Q2 adjusted EPS $3.75 on $1.74B revenue; management expects high end of $20/kg LCE scenario, implying full-year sales $5.7-6B. Q2 realized lithium price $19.53/kg LCE. CEO Kent Masters: energy storage demand 'off the charts', consumption up 45% YoY through May.

items.headline: Big Charlotte employer taps outsider as new CEO
items.snippet: Albemarle preparing to reopen dormant Kings Mountain lithium mine (NC) after completing federal permitting. Q2 net sales $1.7B, up 31% YoY, driven by energy storage/data center demand.

items.headline: Albemarle's Next CEO Inherits A $250 Million Swing Per Dollar
items.snippet: JPMorgan cut Albemarle's 2026 adjusted EBITDA estimate 14.4% to $2.88B on Chinese lithium prices averaging $21,625/ton in Q3 (down from $24,810 in Q2). Each $1/kg move shifts annual EBITDA ~$250M. Chinese EV sales fell 13% H1 2026 but global lithium consumption jumped 45% through

items.headline: Market Chatter: Lithium Miners' Profits Surge as Battery Storage Demand Drives Prices Higher
items.snippet: Chinese lithium producers posted strongest H1 net income in 3 years; Chinese spot lithium prices up 22% YTD. Albemarle noted global lithium demand grew 45% through May, outstripping supply.
